meta.name: Cupertino
meta.description: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

videos.title: Michael & Olivia
videos.overview: Michael and Olivia launch their own law firm to represent victims of tech elite exploitation, battling Silicon Valley's Goliaths. Michael's former assistant, Christy Palladino, uses her family connections to help.

videos.title: Vik & Bo
videos.overview: Michael and Olivia defend Vik Malhotra, a Silicon Valley coder being held responsible for an errant drone that killed an onlooker during an elaborate drone display; Christy vets a potential new whistleblower client.

videos.title: Juno
videos.overview: As part of the deal to fund the firm, Natalia asks Michael and Olivia to take over a case to represent a distraught mother who believes a companion chatbot is responsible for her son's patricide. Also, in an attempt to throw Michael off his game the chatbot company brings in his ex-girlfriend, Nichole, as opposing counsel.

videos.title: A.J. & Buddy
videos.overview: Michael and Olivia defend the young founders of a prediction market site, one of whom has been arrested while the other flees on his private jet with Christy in tow after a night out together. Meanwhile, Natalia and Nichole spend quality time together at the firm.

videos.title: Celeste
videos.overview: Olivia recruits her friend Celeste to be the lead plaintiff in a class-action lawsuit against an AI training company accused of wage and overtime abuse. Meanwhile, Michael, Christy and Natalia track down someone with information on Bo.

videos.title: Harper
videos.overview: When Christy’s roommate is denied a transplant due to an AI algorithm swapping the order of the list to put a wealthy man above her, Michael and Olivia race to get a judge on board to stop the surgery. Meanwhile, due to a traffic jam, everyone involved must fight this legal battle remotely from their cars.

videos.title: YUNGWOOD
videos.overview: Michael and Olivia try to save art and original music by suing an AI-music studio that is releasing copycat songs and negatively impacting legendary rapper Yungwood’s (Method Man) streaming revenue. Also, Michael fights through familial disagreements when he goes up against his dad as opposing counsel.

videos.title: Judith & Michael
videos.overview: Michael and Olivia defend a journalist who is framed for murder in a case that exposes the vast surveillance apparatus tracking every American.
